answer.rationale: Current context shows activation down 6% QoQ and competitive pressure on SMB pricing. Memory 73 demonstrated 31% uplift in paid conversions and 18% revenue growth in low-touch segment over 12 weeks. Memory 31 shows onboarding simplification drives activation, but current declines suggest activation is already constrained—pricing may be the primary barrier. Verifying memory_31 and memory_73 to confirm: (1) whether simplified onboarding remains viable given current QoQ declines suggest structural shift, and (2) whether promotional pricing's prior lift can be reproduced or adapted. A small_guarded_test of time-limited promotional pricing on SMB tier addresses immediate competitive threat while preserving the ability to layer onboarding improvements afterward. Risk: promotional pricing can erode perceived value and LTV if not carefully bounded. Preserving uncertainty by starting small, measuring cohort quality not just conversion, and retaining ability to test activation_messaging separately once pricing stabilizes.
